_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_measured_on: e35a26f — merge of feat/paperclip-pack into main, 2026-08-14, twenty packs, clean tree with no nested worktree present
_raised: validate.py 2294 -> 2422, validate_palette.py 1156 -> 1280, sloplint.py 478 -> 498: the paperclip pack, merged after ora and tenor. Additive and nothing was lowered -- one pack markdown, one token layer, a kit of thirteen components with their docs, four reciprocal fork clauses and seven enumeration sites. The palette gate moves furthest because paperclip ships twelve badge gradient pairs with their own hand-picked inks -- 24 colours no other pack has -- on top of a four-colour status set per theme, each parsed and each separated against its peers under three dichromacies. Two measurements exist for this branch and only the merged one is a floor: 2189/1125/470 was the branch alone at eighteen packs, and a floor taken there would have been below main's own.
